clpr.art: Dark near-black field (#0e0c13) with muted white (#eeedf7), electric purple (#8c5cff) and mint green (#3ddc97). Overlapping cropped clip cards, play-triangle geometry, crisp flat vector shapes with subtle grain. Energetic, nocturnal, a little playful.

patchwork.art: Warm paper (#f2efe7) with soft green ink (#365448), deep green (#12664f), tomato (#e85d3f) accents and a little yellow. Hand-stitched fabric patches with large, slightly uneven stitches, ordinary neighborhood objects (a porch, a bag of groceries, a bicycle, a crib) drawn like a quilted community board. Warm, unhurried, never heroic or urgent. Never a real address, map pin on a real place or identifiable person.

hasanara.art: Newsprint paper (#eeeae1) on near-black (#0f0f0f) with broadcast red (#ff3333) and orange (#ff6633). Public-television and broadsheet furniture: a vintage studio microphone, a clock, stacked newspapers, a reel of tape, a timestamp ticker drawn as abstract marks. Mock-solemn, editorial, halftone texture. Never a real person, face, politician or streamer.

rekolekt.art: Index green field (#16201b) with paper (#f2eee5), lime (#b8df72) and sage (#8d9e8a). Archival objects: card catalogue drawers, reels, a long ribbon of audio waveform turning into neat rows of index cards, brackets. Quiet, exact, library-calm, fine linework.

subcult-os.art: Black field (#000000) with white, purple (#7c3aed) and cyan (#00ffff). A small venue at doors time seen as a run sheet: a clipboard, an admit-one ticket stub tilted 3 degrees, a hand stamp, a door with a light above it, a wall clock. Terminal-clean geometry with 8px rounded corners, flat colors, no glamour.

undertow.art: Dark violet field (#0f0c1c) with pink (#ff9fe0), cyan (#9cecff) and lilac. Sound turning into motion: spectrum bars, waveform ribbons, VU meter needles, layered translucent shapes with hard offset shadows and chromatic pink/cyan offsets, square geometry. Loud but precise.

kork.art: Cork board texture (#d4a56c) with paper cards (#fbf6ec), ink (#1b130c) and cobalt pushpins (#2340e8). Index cards and flyers pinned at slight angles by a venue door, chummy hand-made feel. No platform logos.

subcult.art: Poster press: purple field (#8b5cf6), ink (#100b19), acid green (#00ff88) blocks and registration marks, off-white (#f0ece4). Risograph texture, condensed poster energy, flyers pasted on a wall.
